title: Healthy Millet Mix Powder - Sprouted Grains & Dry Fruits

details.description:
Nourish your family with the goodness of Millex Healthy Millet Mix, a wholesome blend of 30 carefully selected natural ingredients. Made with sprouted grains, nutrient-rich millets, cereals, pulses, dry fruits, nuts, seeds, and aromatic spices, this traditional health mix delivers balanced nutrition in every serving. Rich in protein, dietary fibre, minerals, and essential nutrients, it is an ideal everyday nutrition drink for children, adults, and senior citizens. Free from added sugar, preservatives, artificial flavours, colours, and additives, Millex offers a natural and convenient way to support a healthy lifestyle. Simply prepare it with water or milk and enjoy it sweet with jaggery or savoury with salt.
Traditional health mix made with 30 natural ingredients
Prepared using sprouted grains for wholesome nutrition
Contains 9 varieties of millets, 10 cereals and pulses, and 11 dry fruits, seeds, and spices
Rich in protein, dietary fibre, calcium, iron, potassium, and magnesium
No added sugar, preservatives, artificial flavours, colours, or additives
Suitable for all age groups as a daily nutritious drink
Can be prepared as a sweet or savoury beverage
Ready in approximately 5 minutes
Vegetarian product

title: Healthy Millet Mix Powder with Arogyamrutha Churna

details.description: Millex Healthy Millet Mix with Arogyamrutha Churna is a nourishing powdered beverage mix crafted from a wholesome blend of nine millets, cereals, pulses, dry fruits, seeds and 18 Ayurvedic herbs. Ready in just 5 minutes, simply mix with water or milk and cook for a comforting, flavourful drink. Enriched with ingredients such as browntop millet, finger millet, almonds, chia seeds, flax seeds, Ashwagandha, Shatavari, Dry Ginger and Cinnamon, it offers a convenient way to enjoy a balanced daily beverage. Free from added sugar, preservatives, artificial flavours, colours and additives, it is an ideal choice for a healthy lifestyle.

details.description: Millex Millets Rava Idli Instant Mix makes it easy to prepare soft, fluffy idlis in just 15 minutes. Crafted with a wholesome blend of foxtail millet, little millet and kodo millet, this ready-to-cook breakfast mix combines traditional ingredients with everyday convenience. Simply add curd, prepare the batter and steam to enjoy delicious idlis with authentic homemade taste. Seasoned with curry leaves, mustard, green chilli and ginger, it delivers a flavourful breakfast that pairs perfectly with coconut chutney, sambar or your favourite accompaniment. Ideal for busy mornings, this instant mix offers a quick, tasty and satisfying meal for the whole family.
details.ingredients: Foxtail Millet, Little Millet, Kudo Millet, Semolina, Edible Oil, Bengal Gram Dal, Cashew Nut, Salt, Curry Leaves, Raising Agent (INS 500 ii), Anti Caking Agent (INS 551), Mustard, Green Chilli, Ginger

details.description: Millex Multi Millets Dosa Instant Mix offers a quick and convenient way to prepare a wholesome breakfast at home. Ready in just 15 minutes, simply add water to make the batter and cook crisp, delicious dosas with ease. Made with a blend of millets, this instant mix is ideal for busy mornings and everyday meals, bringing convenience and variety to your breakfast routine.
details.ingredients:
Foxtail Millet, Kudo Millet, Proso Millet, Little Millet, Red Rice, Urad Dal, Semolina, Salt, Curry Leaves, Ginger, Red Chilli, Raising Agent (INS 500 ii), Fenugreek.
Allergen Info: May contain gluten

details.description: Millex Multi Millets Upma Mix is a wholesome instant breakfast mix made with a nutritious blend of Proso Millet, Kodo Millet, Little Millet and Foxtail Millet for a satisfying start to your day. Ready in just 15 minutes, simply add boiling water and vegetables of your choice to prepare a warm, flavourful meal. Seasoned with cumin seeds, curry leaves, mustard, ginger and green chilli, it delivers authentic homemade taste with minimal effort. Ideal for busy mornings, this ready-to-cook mix combines convenience with traditional goodness, making it a delicious choice for breakfast or a light meal any time of the day.
details.ingredients: Proso Millet, Kudo Millet, Little Millet, Foxtail Millet, Semolina, Edible Oil, Cumin Seeds, Bengal Gram Dal, Cashew Nut, Salt, Curry Leaves, Raising Agent (INS 500 ii), Citric Acid, Mustard, Green Chilli, Ginger.

details.description: Millex Mother Root – The Perfect Nutritional Start for Your Baby.  Millex Mother Root is a carefully crafted blend of 10 traditional ingredients, including Sprouted Finger Millet, Sprouted Green Gram, Red Rice, Dry Fruits, and Spices. Specially formulated for infants aged 6 to 30 months, this wholesome mix supports your baby’s transition to solid foods while ensuring complete nourishment. Packed with essential vitamins, minerals, proteins, and fibre, it aids digestion, boosts immunity, and provides sustained energy for growing children.
details.ingredients:
Finger Millet (24%), Red Rice (24%), Green Gram (10%), Toor Dal, Almond, Cashew Nut, Pista, Masoor Dal, Wheat, Cardamom.
Allergen Advice: Contains Cashew Nut and Barley. May contain traces of other Nuts.

title: Mother Root Baby Food - Carrot & Almond

details.description: Mother Root Carrot & Almond Baby Food is a carefully crafted cereal blend made with carrot, almond, green gram, red rice, sorghum, cashew, cardamom and dry dates powder. Suitable for babies from 6 to 30 months, it offers a smooth texture that is easy to prepare and ideal as part of your baby's everyday complementary feeding routine.
details.ingredients:
Carrot, Almond, Green Gram, Red Rice, Sorghum, Cardamom, Cashew, Dry Dates Powder.
Allergen Note: Made in a Facility that Processes Wheat & Nuts. May Contain Trace Elements.

title: Mother Root Baby Food - Fruits & Nuts

details.description: Mother Root Fruits & Nuts Baby Food is a carefully crafted blend made with wholesome grains, fruits and nuts to provide a smooth, easy-to-prepare meal for babies aged 6 to 30 months.
